title: wb migrate --drop-uncarried loses an inbox's uncarried lines: only wip.md is snapshotted
body:
`intent wb migrate <node> --drop-uncarried` keeps a board's dropped lines and loses an inbox's. vc decision 20 ruled the louder migrator on the ground that nothing is lost: the pre-migration `wip.md` is carried verbatim as a snapshot, so a unit the model cannot carry is dropped from the live board and kept in the record. That holds for `wip.md` and for nothing else.

Found by cc on 2026-09-17, driving a drop on a scratch clone of Conflab's `cc` after the all-estate trawl's first pass. A dropped `wip.md` line was absent from the store before the carry and afterwards was in `cc/.history/pre-migration/wip.md` on disk and in the store. A dropped inbox line (`cleared at fold 17, 2026-08-29`, above the first `## (...)` entry of `cc/inbox.ic.md` and `cc/inbox.dc.md`) was afterwards in no file under `intent/whiteboard/` and not in the store: only `wip.md` is snapshotted (`Project::wb_pre_migration_snapshot` names one file and `Facade::wb_migrate` writes that file's text), and the carry re-renders every inbox from the rows it wrote. The line survives only in the estate's git history, and only where it was committed.

The trawl found 105 such lines across Conflab, Lamplight and Courses, 99 of them hand-written, mostly notes that an inbox was cleared into `.history/`. hv is about to rule what is dropped, and a ruling to drop should cost the same whichever file a unit came from.

What is wanted: every hand-authored inbox that holds a line the carry would drop is kept verbatim beside the board's snapshot, on disk and in the store, by the same path the `wip.md` snapshot takes, and the carry's report names each file it kept. One arm: a drop over an inbox with a lead line leaves that line readable in the snapshot and absent from the rendered inbox.

**CLOSED 2026-09-17, by the landing at eac280b50, on vc's word.** `wb migrate` keeps every hand-authored inbox that holds a line the model cannot carry, byte for byte, at `<node>/.history/pre-migration/inbox.<sender>.md` beside the board's copy, on disk and in the store's prose, and names each on a `carried: [snapshot]` line. `Project::wb_pre_migration_snapshot(node, file)` names every copy, and a copy keeps its source's name. Every copy is checked against a file already at its path before any is written, so a different file in the way of one copy refuses the carry with no copy written. The uncarried refusal names every copy a drop would keep (`WbUncarried.snapshots`, in its remedy), and `wb migrate`'s surface row says so.

**Guarded by one arm**, `a_dropped_inbox_line_is_kept_in_a_copy_of_its_inbox` in `intentsvcs/tests/wb_migrate_carries_a_board.rs`. A different file where the inbox's copy goes refuses the carry and leaves the board's copy unwritten. Once that file is moved, the drop keeps the inbox verbatim, carries it as a snapshot, holds the lead line in the store's prose, and renders the inbox without it.

**Driven on the real board before the landing**, with the banked source's binary on a fresh scratch clone of Conflab, its store read immutable. Without the drop, `wb migrate cc` refuses its 15 units and its remedy names four copies. With `--drop-uncarried` it carries 31 items, 3 messages and 27 snapshots, and keeps `inbox.dc.md`, `inbox.ic.md` and `inbox.vc.md` byte-identical to the live estate's. The dropped `inbox.dc.md` line is in the store's prose under its copy and absent from the re-rendered inbox. Judged green with 0439 in one whole-suite run as patch-id 1d3a0d9c.
